build_buffer_package: run python3 setup.py build develop to build and install the buffer package with C++ extensions
install_buffer_pip: run pip install . to install the buffer package and its torch dependency
review_build_ext_class: review the custom build_ext class that runs make develop before building extensions
refactor_build_ext_class: refactor the build_ext class to change the make develop command or add additional build steps
test_buffer_package: run the buffer package test suite configured in setup.test_suite via setup.py
